notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible. The two hinged doors of the wall cabinet are reported separately because they are opened in successive manipulations; their individual closing midpoints are less certain because both closures occur within the short interval between frames 552 and 560.
scene_description: A user surveys a narrow modern kitchen, then opens and closes a food-storage drawer left of the stove, separately opens and closes both doors of the wall cabinet above the stove, and finally opens and closes a utensil/storage drawer right of the stove.
